BiblicalUsage: Heres is a mountain in Palestine, named once, where the Amorites held on after the rest of the land was taken. The house of Joseph pressed them and they stayed in Mount Heres, in Aijalon and in Shaalbim, until Israel grew strong enough to put them to tribute.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the record keeps even the unfinished battles, because God's people did not conquer everything at once.
